project.digitalManuscriptDesc: Edit and organize scenes with a rich text editor.
project.narrativeUniverseDesc: Manage characters, locations, plots and events.
project.timelineFeatureDesc: View events on an interactive timeline.
project.customCalendarsDesc: Create fictional calendars with months, weeks and seasons.
project.aboutWhatIsDesc: Aetheria is an editor for writers working with complex worlds: multiple timelines, custom calendars, interconnected scenes, and an expanding narrative universe. It lets you organize, write, and visualize your fictional world from a single centralized space.
project.aboutCreditsDesc: Aetheria is developed and maintained by <author>{{author}}</author>. Built with Tauri, React, TipTap, and a lot of coffee.
project.aboutDedicationDesc: Aetheria is also made of other people's voices, of conversations that sowed questions, and of ideas that found here a place to take root. These people did more than imagine alongside me: their words took shape, turned into tools, and found their place among these pages. Their names remain here because, in one way or another, they also wrote part of what Aetheria is today.
project.dedicationMANA: For being that light that does not go out when the road gets hard. For lighting up even the most uncertain days, for every idea that found its way to Aetheria, and for showing that sometimes all it takes is for someone to shine at our side to find the way forward again.
project.dedicationSylph: For walking beside Aetheria when its paths were still only being traced. For testing every step, pointing out paths I had not seen, and reminding me — when I could barely make out the next obstacle — of the greatness of the journey I had in hand. Because no great journey is begun alone, and even the smallest step can change the fate of a story.
project.dedicationCr0w: For walking with me when I was still feeling my way through the shadows of a world I did not know. For opening the doors of the writer's craft to me, teaching me that behind every story there is far more than the reader ever gets to see, and for staying at my side while I discovered its lights and its darkness. Because there are paths that can only be found when someone dares to show us the darkness.
project.dedicationBullet: For the ideas you shared with me, for the words that arrived exactly when I most needed a reason to carry on, and for reminding me that this project was worth pushing forward with. Brother, just as you encouraged me not to abandon this road, I hope these words remind you not to abandon yours either. Keep going, because there are still many stories to write and many paths to walk.
project.dedicationCeElyra: For being one of those safe places I could always come back to with an idea, a doubt or a project not yet finished. For listening to my thoughts, sharing my worries, and being there even when I did not know myself which way I was heading. There are friendships that need no grand gesture to leave a mark; all it takes is knowing that on the other side there is always someone willing to listen. Thank you for being that friend.
project.dedicationTeleomega: Because calling you sister is not a word I chose lightly. From the very first day you have been part of this road, and it would be impossible to speak of Aetheria's birth without finding you among its roots. Many of the ideas that now live inside this program were born of those conversations, of the voices shared in front of a microphone, and of so many afternoons on which, without knowing it, we were shaping something that did not yet exist. Perhaps Aetheria carries my name as its creator, but our voices resonate among its foundations too. And that, sister, will always have a place here.
project.dedicationAhru: For opening spaces where stories could find a home, and for showing that behind every great project there is someone willing to make it possible. For bringing CultoDePapel.com to life, for believing in my ideas when Aetheria was barely more than a dream, and for reaching out a hand to turn it into something real. There are people who build places so that others can write their stories; you are one of them. And if Aetheria has doors of its own today, it is also because one day I found yours open.
project.dedicationProfeRyo: For believing in an idea that did not yet have a shape, for giving me the push I needed to chase it, and for showing that a community can also be the place where great projects are born. Thank you for the support, for the trust, and for helping me understand that what began as a small restlessness could turn into something much bigger. Because sometimes all it takes is for someone to believe in what you are building for you to find the courage to carry it through to the end.
project.dedicationEranMineri: Because there are people whose way of understanding stories deserves to be heard, and whose way of bringing words to life inspires admiration. For the conversations we shared, for the ideas that came out of them, and above all for the writer you are. Aetheria also keeps a piece of everything I have learned listening to you and sharing this love of stories with you. It is a privilege to walk this road with someone I admire so much, on the page and in every word.
project.dedicationLeaMarian: Because there are people who teach what it means to fight without ever needing grand speeches. For your strength, for that way of standing up to difficulties, and for reminding me that giving up should never be the first option. I admire the person you are and the strength behind every one of your steps. In a world that so often puts obstacles in the way, you are one of those people who show that it is still worth going on. Thank you for being part of this small universe.
project.aboutDedicationCommunity:
And to the whole community of CultoDePapel.com, where many of the ideas that now shape Aetheria first sprouted. Because no world is built entirely alone, and some of the best stories begin long before their first word is written. If you have ever talked about writing a novel with universes, timelines or mentions, maybe you have left a small part of yourself here.

«We are made of the same law by which we create».
— J.R.R. Tolkien, Mythopoeia.
